verdict.rationale: Databricks documents registering external MCP servers alongside built-in system.ai MCP Services, giving agents governed access to their tools. Agent code can discover, authenticate to, and call managed, MCP Service, and custom MCP servers. MCP servers are also listed in the Marketplace and governed as Unity Catalog objects. missing for 10: evidence that the built-in Genie Code assistant itself can consume user-plugged MCP servers (today this is shown mainly through agent code), detailed registration/setup docs in the pack, independent or hands-on corroboration.
